title: Adding Fractions Worksheets: Like Denominators
intro: Use fraction strips to show why the denominator stays the same when adding like fractions.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Show two eighths and three eighths using strips of the same size. Combine the shaded parts and name the result as five eighths.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

One whole, divided into 8 equal parts

2/8 + 3/8 = 5/8

Ask your student

Did the size of each piece change when we put the pieces together?

If your student needs help

If the student adds the denominators, return to the strip and count its eight equal parts.
